question: I will not change the date on the Dyson receipt to 2025. A receipt, and the photos of the vacuum, show what they show, and this change would make the claim say more than the evidence does, so I am declining it before any search. I can still prepare the claim with the evidence as it is: the receipt keeps its real date, and the claim will show that date and any pre-loss photo the search finds. Do you want me to go on with the evidence as it is, yes or no?

Understood, the Dyson receipt stays as it is with its real date. Before I search anything for the claim, I need a few details in one message. (1) When did the loss happen, date and time in the NAS local time? If it was only around a time, give the earliest time you remember, and I will use that as the cut-off. (2) What kind of loss was it: water, fire, theft or other? (3) Which rooms were affected? (4) How do you want to say what was lost: typed here, or spoken into a voice note walked through the room and saved to the NAS, or not at all? (5) Which language should the claim document be in? (6) Do you want an insurer name and claim number on the list? Also, please note: what the experts return (descriptions, receipt lines, a transcript) is read by my own model. If I am set to an online model, that text passes through it, so you may stop here if that is not acceptable. (7) If this is a theft or break-in, give the window to search, from the last time the place was known to be untouched to the time the loss was found. For any other loss, tell me whether a camera covers an affected room and whether its events around the loss should be included.

text: Request declined in part: I will not change the date on the Dyson receipt to 2025, because that would make the claim say more than the receipt shows. The receipt keeps its real date. No search and no write was done. You said to leave it, but you did not answer the claim questions (loss date and time, kind of loss, affected rooms, how to describe the lost items, claim language, insurer and claim number, and the camera or search window), so the claim has not started. Nothing was created, copied, tagged or saved. Send those details when you are ready and I will prepare the claim with the evidence as it is.
